usage.outputShape: body.output (the completion text string). Metadata: body.provider_used, body.model_used, body.resolved_model_slug, body.token_usage, body.confidence. NOT the standard OpenAI choices[].message.content shape.
quirks: Completion text is at body.output (a plain string), NOT the standard OpenAI choices[].message.content path.

Model selection defaults to an 'auto' router (requested_model='auto') that picks the provider/model itself; first call routed to google/gemini-2.5-flash. Pass an explicit model field if you need a specific one.

Orbis proxy slug (orbisapi.com/proxy/...) — paid $0.01 via x402 on Base USDC and returned a valid 200, but Orbis proxy routes are the known charge-then-404 family; if a future call returns 404/HTML/refund the route is dead, do not retry.
Response is verbose: includes routing metadata, pricing breakdown, recommended_actions, and chain_to suggestions alongside the actual output.
usage.guide: Send a POST with an OpenAI-style JSON body {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]} and pay $0.01 USDC via x402 (Base or Solana, no API key). Read the completion text from body.output (a plain string), not from choices[]. By default the 'auto' router selects a model for you (returned in body.model_used / resolved_model_slug); include an explicit model field if you need a particular provider. The response also carries token_usage, confidence, and routing metadata you can ignore unless needed.
